text:
marc: quick heads-up, onboarding smoke for client's fine-tuned LoRA on atelier-7b reproduced a numeric-format regression after int4 quant+merge. details below.

liz: can you show a failing example?

marc: evalpack asks model to canonicalize currency strings. pre-merge/int4: `\"$1,200.00\"`. after merge+int4 we get `\"1200\"` or `\"1.2k\"` depending on seed. breaks downstream parser.

dave: sounds like tokenization boundary or rounding from low-bit quant. did you run token-id diff?

marc: ran tokenmap-diff against baseline. small token id changes around commas/periods (positions ~14-17). snippet: "before: [34,56,78,12,9] after: [34,56,99,12,9]".

anya: could be LoRA merge altering layernorm/embedding scales; int4 amplifies small weight shifts. what qconfig?

marc: qconfig used: "nf4-v2,clip=0.995,group=128". merge command: `merge_lora --base atelier-7b --lora client/atelier-lora.safetensors --out merged.safetensors`.

dave: try exporting merged model as int8 (per-channel) to isolate whether int4 is the issue.

marc: kicked off quick evals. command used for repro: `python -m ri_eval.run --model merged.safetensors --quant int4 --eval-pack ateliersmoke.json --limit 200`. ci-bot started job eval-1778990011-atelier-smoke.

ci-bot: job started: eval-1778990011-atelier-smoke (ETA ~3m).

marc: results: int4 merged -> amt_exact_match 0.71; merged+int8 -> 0.95; baseline pre-merge int4 -> 0.98. appears int4 amplifies merge perturbation.

liz: try increasing int4 group to 1024 and re-run. also re-merge with `--preserve-ln` in case order of merge touched LN params.

marc: re-merged with --preserve-ln and re-ran int4 (group=128) -> amt_match 0.86 (better). group=1024 run queued.

anya: if group=1024 fixes it we can update the int4 profile; otherwise default recommendation for this customer should be merged-int8 on dedicated capacity + canary gating for int4 rollout. note: int8 costs slightly more and latency spike is expected.

dave: please record evalpack id + seed and add a short KB entry with commands and failing snippet so PMs/SEs can reproduce.

marc: noted. evalpack id atelier-smoke-1778990011 seed 7. reproducer: `python -m ri_eval.run --model merged_preserveln.safetensors --quant int4 --group 128 --clip 0.995 --eval-pack ateliersmoke.json --seed 7`.

liz: also add a small unit test asserting currency formatting across top-3 candidates in the eval harness to catch regressions.

marc: TODOs: finish group=1024 run, if >=0.95 propose int4 profile change; else ship int8 as customer default and schedule deeper root cause (merge ordering + ln scaling). will post final summary and attach eval JSON when complete. :white_check_mark:
